function_v0.doc:
Open a one-input/one-output escrow order using the actual post-fee/source-swap amount.

`amount` is positive source-token base units, argument index 2 excluding `Env`;
router registration uses `amount_arg_index = 2`, `amount_field = None`.
`terms` supplies the signed destination floor and fixed-point quote multiplier.

# Authorization and effects
The user authorizes these full arguments plus escrow's order-ID commitment and
exact transfer subcalls. Never transfers funds or authorizes on the user's behalf.
Calls escrow `open`, emits `IntentOpened`, and returns the canonical order ID.
Any error rolls back the whole transaction, including router fees/source swaps.

# Errors
Quote/conversion errors from `build_order`, configuration errors, or
escrow/token/auth failures. Changed realized amounts require new authorization.
The router ignores the return; recover the full order from escrow's `Opened` event.
function_v0.name: open

function_v0.doc:
Return immutable escrow and chain configuration without user authorization.

Maintains instance/code TTL. Returns `NotConfigured` when configuration is missing.
The adapter stores no per-order data.
function_v0.name: get_config

function_v0.doc:
Bind the immutable native `escrow`, OIF origin `chain_id`, and Stellar `network_id`.

No admin or later configuration path exists. `AddressType` rejects a non-contract
escrow; `WrongNetwork` rejects a mismatching ledger network. The constructor does
not query escrow's chain configuration: choose matching values or escrow will
reject orders. Stores instance configuration and maintains instance/code TTL.
function_v0.name: __constructor

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The shared cross-chain output, field for field the reference `MandateOutput`.
Every field is a wire identifier, so `token`, `settler` and `oracle` are raw
32-byte IDs and `recipient` is a raw 32-byte payload rather than a native
`Address`: the output may live on any chain and is hashed into proofs as-is.
`amount` is the original mandate amount; Dutch pricing never changes it.
udt_struct_v0.name: MandateOutput

fields.doc: Original unsigned destination base-unit amount; context pricing does not alter the commitment.
fields.name: amount

fields.doc: Opaque destination callback bytes, at most 256; Stellar fills require empty bytes.
fields.name: callback_data

fields.doc: Full unsigned 256-bit OIF destination chain ID.
fields.name: chain_id

fields.doc: Opaque fulfillment context, at most 256 bytes; local execution uses supported exact layouts.
fields.name: context

fields.doc: Raw output-oracle ID; the source adapter must attest in this exact namespace.
fields.name: oracle

fields.doc: Destination recipient identifier; Stellar uses the raw G key or C ID typed by the context tag.
fields.name: recipient

fields.doc: Destination token identifier; Stellar uses the raw SAC/C-contract ID.
fields.name: token
